name: CODEXA
long_description:
Our agents run tax, customs clearance, and supply chain workflows, helping companies navigate complex regulations and reduce the cost of international trade. By running these operations, Codexa becomes the natural platform for customers’ payments and foreign exchange.

We execute transactions through our own financial institution, regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil, connecting operational workflows directly to financial infrastructure. Customers approve payments, and Codexa moves the money through traditional and stablecoin rails.

Today, 51 enterprise customers use our agents, and 84% have adopted our financial products. We process approximately $800M in monthly financial volume, including $160M settled through stablecoins. Our customers include Fortune 500 and Global 500 companies.
one_liner: The AI-native financial platform for enterprises
